description: Read validated historical OJ sales, calculate course-aligned forecasts and errors, apply escalation rules, and produce a one-week planning recommendation. No external actions.

scenario_last_week_units.description: Optional explicitly hypothetical week 160 demand; does not update real source.

missing_last_week.description: True when a revised case makes week 160 unavailable and forbids consulting the original figure.

claimed_last_week_units.description: Conflicting claimed actual; human must determine source of truth.

outputs: JSON with status, source, validation+holdout metrics, selected model, forecast_week, forecast_units, warnings, and human approval condition; escalation statuses omit forecast.
